title: Storage conditions
scope: How to store Velquanor 10 mg tablets: temperature, moisture, original package.
text: Velquanor 10 mg film-coated tablets should be stored below 25°C in the original package to protect them from moisture. They should not be used after the expiry date printed on the carton and blister.

title: Missed dose
scope: What to do after a missed dose of Velquanor.
text: If a dose is missed, take it with the next meal.

title: Missed dose
scope: What the patient leaflet says about a missed dose of Velquanor.
text: The Patient Information Leaflet for Velquanor states that a missed dose should be taken as soon as it is remembered, unless it is almost time for the next dose, and that a double dose should not be taken to make up for a forgotten one. For individual advice, please speak to your doctor or pharmacist.

title: Excipients: lactose and gluten
scope: Whether Velquanor tablets contain lactose, gluten or other excipients of note.
text: Each Velquanor 10 mg tablet contains 45 mg of lactose monohydrate. The tablets do not contain gluten. The full list of excipients is given in section 6.1 of the Summary of Product Characteristics.

title: Administration with food
scope: Whether Velquanor can be taken with or without food; how to swallow the tablet.
text: According to the Summary of Product Characteristics, Velquanor 10 mg tablets can be taken with or without food. The tablet should be swallowed whole with a glass of water.

title: Storage and in-use shelf life
scope: How to store Orvatil 0.1% cream and how long a tube can be used after opening.
text: Orvatil 0.1% cream should be stored below 25°C and must not be frozen. Once the tube has been opened, the cream should be used within 3 months.

title: Pack sizes
scope: Which pack sizes of Orvatil cream exist.
text: Orvatil 0.1% cream is supplied in 30 g and 60 g tubes. For current stock levels, please contact your usual wholesaler.

title: Excipients
scope: Excipients of note in Orvatil cream (e.g. cetostearyl alcohol, preservatives).
text: Orvatil 0.1% cream contains cetostearyl alcohol and benzyl alcohol. The full list of excipients is given in section 6.1 of the Summary of Product Characteristics.

title: Storage and in-use shelf life
scope: How to store Brenquilo oral solution and how long a bottle can be used after opening.
text: Brenquilo 2 mg/ml oral solution should be stored below 25°C and should not be refrigerated. After first opening, the bottle should be used within 28 days.

title: Measuring device
scope: Which measuring device is supplied with Brenquilo.
text: Each carton of Brenquilo 2 mg/ml oral solution contains a 10 ml oral syringe marked in 0.5 ml steps. Only the syringe supplied in the carton should be used to measure the dose.

title: Sugar and alcohol content
scope: Whether Brenquilo contains sugar, sweeteners or alcohol.
text: Brenquilo 2 mg/ml oral solution is sugar-free. It is sweetened with sorbitol (150 mg per ml) and does not contain alcohol.

title: Product information documents
scope: Requests for a copy of the Summary of Product Characteristics or the Patient Information Leaflet of any Nordvale product.
text: The current Summary of Product Characteristics and Patient Information Leaflet for this product can be provided on request. Our Medical Information team will send the approved documents in a separate message.
